SD27-003.name: Eridanus-Dragon
SD27-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Cost 3 or less Spirits are destroyed by opposing effects, they can remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning a "Galaxian" family Spirit card, by exhausting this Spirit, treat all the reduction symbols of that Spirit card as fulfilled.

SD27-001.name: Pixislizard
SD27-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [SSoul: Red]
When you're summoning an Ultimate card, this Spirit gains [Red Core] (an extra Red Symbol).

[LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
All "Galaxian" family Spirit cards in your Hand/Removed Zone become Cost 5.

SD27-005.name: The GenesisDragon Bayer
SD27-005.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 1 or higher Spirits]

[LV3][LV4][LV5] (Your Turn)
When your "Galaxian" family Spirit effects would target opposing Spirits, you can also target opposing Ultimates.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, return a Spirit card from your Trash to your Hand.
[utb]

SD27-X01.name: The GenesisDragon Ptolemy
SD27-X01.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Cost 3 or higher Spirits]

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this Ultimate card without paying the cost. Then, if your Life is three or less, destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, destroy every opposing Nexus, and draw two cards.
[utb]

SD27-004.name: The TimeGuardian Horolo-Gium
SD27-004.effect:
The cost of this Spirit card in Hand is the same as the number of your Lives.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon any number of "Galaxian" family Brave cards from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

SD27-X02.name: The UltimateStar Ultimate-Zodiac
SD27-X02.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Red Spirit/Ultimate]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, reveal up to twelve cards from your decktop. Summon any number of "Galaxian" family Spirit cards from among them, without paying the cost. Discard any remaining cards.
[utb]

[LV4][LV5]
All your "Galaxian" family Spirits are treated as being on their highest LVs, and gain +5000 BP.

SD27-006.name: The ZodiacStarblade Zodiacsword
SD27-006.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy a Brave on an opposing Brave Spirit.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
By discarding an opposing Burst, put two cores from the Void to this Spirit/Ultimate.

SD27-002.name: Wyvern-Vela
SD27-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By putting any number of "Galaxian" family Spirit cards/"Astral Deity" family Ultimate cards from your Hand to your Removed Zone, for each card put, draw one card.
